doc.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Jimmy Witherspoon joins and 'Ain't Nobody's Business'
summary: Witherspoon came on later wanting to sing the blues, and McShann had a hand in his hit first recording.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Yeah? No kidding. My goodness. And Jimmy Witherspoon came on board a little bit later?
Yes, yes, Spoon came on board later. We had a lot of fun, yes sir. Yeah Spoon wanted to sing the blues. Yeah, he wanted to sing the blues.
You had a big hand in his first recordings, right? “Ain’t Nobody’s Business.”
Yes, yes. Yes that was a big tune. Yes.
